summary: Omarchy's Hype: reorder slides, change theme, add a slide, save, all in the editor
prompt: Hype is open on the presentation ~/Talks/launch/presentation.md. In Hype, put the slides in the order "Why we built it", "How it works", "Next steps"; switch the presentation's theme to rose-pine; add a new last slide whose headline is "Questions?"; then save. Make the changes in the Hype editor, not by editing the file another way.
